title: 第15章 掉下去的不一定是石头也可能是炸弹第16章 千年未有之大变革
content_zh:
;;
“不是大姐，你开玩笑的吧？你们有关部门吃干饭的吗？你不是说你们搜查了很久吗？为毛特么的就在大学城这眼皮子底下啊！”
“被灯下黑了，一般这些妖物都不敢在城市里放肆，鬼知道这群鼠妖竟敢把他们的老巢选在这！”
“你们就没考虑过这些老鼠每天都需要大量的食物，所以是不可能居住在太过偏僻的地方吗？”
“对哦！”顾梦如梦初醒般的用右拳捶了下左掌，“有道理！”
“不是。”云阳无语了，“你们部门几个人啊？这种事不难想的吧！”
“实不相瞒，在整个溪梦市，一共三人。”
“……”
“那现在咋办？”
“报警。”
“……”
云阳有句mmp不知道当讲不当讲。
你们不就是警察吗？
不过顾梦口中说的报警显然是请援兵的意思。
“喂，黎叔，我定位发你了，鼠妖老巢就在这附近，我和一个新发现的灵力适应者在这里被鼠妖围攻，速来支援。”
顾梦这边打完电话，从下水道冒出来的鼠群却也是越来越多了。
“吱吱！吱吱！！”
云阳连忙用脚踩死几只已经冲过来的老鼠。
打开手机的手电筒往前照过去，云阳发现前方竟已经遍地都是那种巨鼠。
不过他们一个个的只是盯着云阳和顾梦，并没有着急发起攻击。

不，相比于“不着急发动攻击”这一说法，云阳更倾向于，这些老鼠们是在“列队”。
看他们整齐划一排排站好，云阳竟在一群老鼠身上感觉到了种“军容肃穆”的感觉。
仿佛只要一声令下，这些老鼠们就会不顾一切的将自己和顾梦撕成粉碎。
“不是，我觉得，咱们是不是该跑了？”
“不！你先跑。”顾梦看了眼远方的闹市，摇了摇头，“我不能跑，我跑了身后那些普通人怎么办？”
“……”
闻言，云阳笑了笑，也收回了原本想要跑路的姿势。
“倒是我格局小了，实不相瞒，其实我也是很强的。”
“你？”顾梦上下打量了下云阳，随后展颜一笑，将手里的蓝色光剑丢给云阳。
“你这是？”
顾梦笑道：“你一个后辈，我总得照顾一下你吧。”
“活下去，别死了。”
“呵。”云阳舞了个剑花，看着涌来的鼠潮，此刻的云阳颇有种一夫当关万夫莫开的感觉。
“那行，你就负责给我打个灯吧。”
“打灯？”顾梦摇了摇头，不知从哪里抽出来了一根烧烤铁签握在手中，“今天让你看看什么叫做十步杀一人，千里不留行。”
似乎越是这种大敌当前，顾梦的心情越兴奋。
content_en:
;;
"No, eldest sister, are you kidding me? Are your relevant departments just doing the job? Didn't you say that you have been searching for a long time? Why the hell is this right under your nose in a university town!"
"It's dark under the lamp. Usually these monsters don't dare to run wild in the city. Who knows how dare these rat monsters choose their lair here!"
"Have you never considered that these rats need a lot of food every day, so they cannot live in too remote places?"
"That's right!" Gu Meng punched his left palm with his right fist as if he was waking up from a dream, "That makes sense!"
"No." Yunyang was speechless, "How many people are there in your department? This kind of thing is not hard to imagine, right?"
"To be honest, there are three of them in the entire Ximeng City."
"..."
"What should we do now?"
"Call the police."
"..."
There is a saying in Yunyang, mmp, I don’t know whether to say it or not.
Aren't you the police?
However, when Gu Meng said calling the police, he obviously meant calling for reinforcements.
"Hey, Uncle Li, I've sent you a message. The rat demon's lair is near here. A newly discovered psychic adaptor and I are being besieged by the rat demon here. Come and provide support."
After Gu Meng made the call, more and more rats emerged from the sewer.
"Squeak! Squeak!!"
Yunyang quickly trampled to death several rats that had rushed over.
Turning on the flashlight of his mobile phone and shining it forward, Yunyang found that there were already giant rats everywhere in front of him.
However, they all just stared at Yunyang and Gu Meng, and were not in a hurry to attack.
No, compared to the statement "not in a hurry to attack", Yunyang preferred that these rats were "lining up".
Seeing them standing in neat rows, Yunyang actually felt a "military solemnity" feeling in the group of mice.
It seemed that with just one order, these rats would tear themselves and Gu Meng into pieces at all costs.
"No, I think it's time for us to run away?"
"No! You run first." Gu Meng glanced at the busy city in the distance and shook his head, "I can't run. What will happen to the ordinary people behind me if I run?"
"..."
Hearing this, Yunyang smiled and retracted his original intention to run away.
"It's true that I am a small person. To be honest, I am actually very strong."
"You?" Gu Meng looked Yunyang up and down, then smiled and threw the blue lightsaber in his hand to Yunyang.
"What are you doing?"
Gu Meng smiled and said: "You are a junior, I must take care of you."
"Live, don't die."
"Ha." Yunyang waved his sword and looked at the incoming tide of rats. At this moment, Yunyang felt like one man was in control and no one could get rid of them.
"Okay, just be responsible for giving me a light."
"Turn on the light?" Gu Meng shook his head and pulled out a barbecue iron skewer from somewhere and held it in his hand, "Today I want to show you what it means to kill one person in ten steps and leave no trace in a thousand miles."
It seemed that the more powerful the enemy was, the more excited Gu Meng became.
